items.title: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 in Azure Functions ends on September 1, 2027
items.summary: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 on Azure Functions is ending on September1, 2027. Your apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, butsecurity updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer providecustomer service for Java 8,
